messages.en: I'm lying in bed now.
Are you getting ready to sleep?
What did you do today?
What do you think I did~?
히히
I have so many pretty photos,

messages.ko: 다 뿌까머리 사진 이후에 찍은거라 공개가 안됐어
messages.en: but they were all taken after the Pucca hairstyle photos, so I can't reveal them yet.
Please be patient just a little longer...
Some legendary photos are coming~
Also,
the main reason I messaged you
is because there's a song I wanted to recommend.
"Romeo & Juliet."
I love it so much that I've been listening to it nonstop.
It reminds me of Y/n so much,
how could I not tell you~
I used to only listen to "Cold,"
but I think this one's taking its place now.
It's George's song, right..?
Yup~
I thought you'd switch to "Warm" instead.
Well, it has been warm lately. ^
I was hoping you'd switch to "Hot Hot."
♪ It's hot, hot, hot~ ♪
I wonder if there's a photo I can send...
I want to show you my face too.
Everything will slowly be revealed soon,
so I'll show you all of it.

messages.ko: 로미오앤 줄리엣을 갑자기 듣게된 계기가 궁금해요
messages.en: I'm curious what made you suddenly start listening to "Romeo & Juliet."
I was binge-listening to Begin Again,
and Suhyun and Crush's cover was so beautiful.
So I looked it up,
and completely fell in love with it.
아 ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
Oh, and I finished watching New Recruit 3.
So I picked up a new impression.
How was that?
Choi Il-gu?
That one's harder. Hang on.
ㅋㄹㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Park Min-seok.
Do Im Da-hye too.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ This one's...
too easy.
Do the platoon leader too.
ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Moon Bitnari, go go.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅇㅋ
Why am I so good at this?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㄹㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It's Mayu-chan's birthday.
I came to wish her a happy birthday~
I've decided... Jeong Hayeon really does have talent for acting.

messages.ko: 나 신병4에 폐급병사로 롤리폴리 추라면 할수있음
messages.en: If they cast me as a hopeless recruit in New Recruit 4 and told me to dance 'Roly Poly,' I could totally do it.
My talent scares even me.
Oh right.
I learned a brand-new dad joke.
The algorithm taught it to me.
Wait a second.
Who do you think a camel's mother is?
A wolf.
"Because the wolf gave birth to a camel."
My sense of humor has been completely dead lately,
so I keep making weird dad jokes.
I said it's dead!!!
I know!!!
You know, jokes like...
"Let's eat Jin Ramen." — "Only if we're winning."
Or...
"Let's eat Shin Ramyun." — "Nah, I'll eat something that's not Shin."
Then the mood instantly gets awkward.
I don't think your sense has died these days, though.
Hey!!
Those are my dad's jokes....
Oh no....

messages.ko: 근데 어쩌지 농담의 수준이 다르더라고 방금 메모에 적음..
messages.en: But what do I do... the joke quality is on a whole different level. I just wrote it down in my notes.
Make sure you keep good notes~ㅎㅎ

messages.ko: 하연이 막 비비빅에 막걸리에 새우깡에 연양갱 먹는 거 아니지?
messages.en: You're not the type to eat Bibibig, makgeolli, shrimp crackers, and Yeonyanggaeng all together... right?
Wouldn't mixing all of that together make poison?
I almost got that tattooed. ㅋㅋㅋ
Let's not do that~ㅎㅎㅎ
But what if your dad actually eats it like that?..
That sounds so delicious!!!
I've wanted to try eating it like that for a long time~><
Eat it tomorrow and prove it.
I'm busy tomorrowㅎㅎㅎㅎ
So it's not poison—you mean you'd happily mix it all together and eat it. ㅎㅎ
I meant mixing it into rice and eating it~
Rice with milk is actually pretty good.
Huh?! What's that supposed to be!!
Just eat cereal...
Chocolate with soy sauce egg rice is seriously delicious too.
Now that's actually going way too far.
I'll believe it if you prove it.
The weirdest thing I've ever eaten was...
recently, Lynn unnie had some natto she'd bought,
and I ate it even though it was over two years past the expiration date.
I thought it was supposed to taste like that.
It did seem kind of sour though;;
I didn't get a stomachache,
and maybe thanks to that,
my digestion's been really good.
Natural probiotics........?
Exactly~ It's like fermented soybean paste.
The more it's aged, the better? ㅎ
Sounds good. I'll buy some today and eat it two years later.
Eat it four years later so you'll be even healthier.

messages.ko: 단체로 웨이브 응급실 가는 거 아냐?
messages.en: Won't all the WAVs end up in the emergency room together?

messages.ko: 그럼 내가 병문안 가서 응급실 불러줄게
messages.en: Then I'll come visit you in the hospital and call out, 'Emergency room!'
Ah, my hair dryer fell,
and my perfume almost broke.
That hair dryer has no manners.
No, actually,
it was the hair dryer holder that fell.
You need to straighten that holder out.
Hey, hair dryer.
Do you think saying sorry means you're done living in the dorm?
Get yourself together.
Anyway, the jacket photos are being uploaded right now.
The thing I'm really worried about is...
I ate two prop ramens during the shoot and practically passed out from the sodium.
Then we started filming right away,
so I'm really nervous about how I ended up looking.
Oh, and...

messages.ko: 나의 고양이메이크업 보고싶어 하는사람이 너무 많은거야
messages.en: So many people have been saying they want to see my cat makeup.
The members too.
They keep asking me to do it.
The vibe might be a little different,
but sometime during these promotions,
I'll try the cat look once.
Like a really fierce look?
Please bring Haseok back too. ㅜ
Haseok never left.

messages.ko: 하연이 오빠분 혹시 마법소녀 정하연 보고 뭐라고 하셔 너무 궁금함
messages.en: I'm really curious—what did your older brother say after seeing Magical Girl Jeong Hayeon?
My brother always just gives me feedback.

messages.ko: 뭐 이렇게 해라 이렇게 해서 웃겨라
messages.en: Things like, 'Do it this way,' or 'Make it funnier like this.'
Stuff like that.
Even normally,

messages.ko: 너가 이렇게 해야한다 너 뭘 잘해야한다
messages.en: he'll tell me, 'You should do this,' or 'You need to get better at that.'
He doesn't really tease me—he just gives advice.
Does your brother also feel like he has to be funny?
If I tell my brother,
"You've lost your touch lately. You're not funny anymore?"
then...
he actually gets bothered by it.
He's basically just Haseok's older brother.
We're exactly the same.

messages.ko: 오빠랑 하연이중에서 누가 더 웃겨 평소에?
messages.en: Between you and your brother, who's funnier on a normal day?

messages.ko: 그냥 서로를 더 웃길려고 무리하는 느낌
messages.en: It just feels like we're both trying too hard to make each other laugh.
Then one of us suddenly goes completely serious, and that's what makes it perfect.
Wow...
I have dark circles now.
I never used to have them.
ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
I'm going to be super busy until our comeback.
But I'm happy.
Y/n, let's only be happy too.
Together with me.

messages.ko: 내 행복 너가 다 가져가 정하연
messages.en: Take all of my happiness, Jeong Hayeon.
Then take all the happiness, and all my love too.
Y/n.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Sleep well.
Good luck tomorrow~
Well... it's already today.
Let's do our best today too. ❤️
Haranghae~ 🥰
